channel.title: Coder Schmoder
channel.description: A tech blog covering .NET, Blazor, C++, AI, software development, and the future of programming. Written by Alejandrio Vasay.

item.title: Copilotification of Microsoft: How a Great Brand Lost Its Meaning
item.description: Microsoft turned Copilot from a clever AI assistant into a confusing label slapped across nearly every product in its ecosystem.

item.title: Quick Blazor Tip: Pass Data Between Components the Right Way
item.description: Learn how to pass data between Blazor components using Parameters and EventCallback—simple patterns for clean, maintainable, and reusable UI code.

item.title: The 1979 Pitch: Convincing Bjarne Stroustrup of C++'s Future
item.description: If you could time-travel to 1979 and met with Bjarne Stroustrup, what would you tell him about the future of C++?

item.title: Implementing Image Caching in .NET: IMemoryCache Tutorial
item.description: Learn how to implement efficient image caching using IMemoryCache in .NET. Complete tutorial with console app example that works in any .NET application.

item.title: Top 20 Jobs Most Likely to Be Replaced by AI (Ranked, 2025–2035)
item.description: Ranked analysis of the top 20 jobs most vulnerable to AI (highest → lowest risk). Evidence-based methodology, 2025–2035 projections, and deep case studies.

item.title: 5 Reasons Why You Should Learn Blazor
item.description: Discover why Blazor is the top choice for .NET developers in 2025. Build full-stack web apps with C#, flexible rendering, and modern components.

item.title: 5 Reasons Why You Should Learn C#
item.description: Learn why C# is a powerful, versatile language worth mastering. Discover five key reasons to start learning C# for web, mobile, gaming, and cloud development.

item.title: How to Implement Image Randomizer Web API
item.description: Create a production-ready image randomizer Web API with ASP.NET Core. Learn caching optimization, dependency injection, and modern .NET best practices

item.title: Blazor Form Validation Part 4: How to Validate Only on Submit
item.description: Stop Blazor form validation on every field change! Learn how to validate only on submit for better UX. Step-by-step guide with code examples.

item.title: Get Random Element from a List in C#(Updated)
item.description: Quick C# tutorial: Get a random element from any List. Learn the modern, thread-safe method using Random.Shared and list index.

item.title: Debunking the Myth of C++ Cybersecurity Concerns(Updated)

item.description: Learn how to use built-in .NET DataAnnotations like [Required] and [EmailAddress] to quickly add robust validation to your Blazor forms.

item.title: Five ways to pass data between components in Blazor
